name: NESCAC Cross Country Championships
where: Middlebury, VT · host Middlebury · Middlebury Cross Country Course
headline: NESCAC: Middlebury, Williams and Tufts women race for the title
summary: No. 2 Middlebury hosts No. 4 Williams and No. 7 Tufts. Middlebury beat Williams 63-65 at the Connecticut College Invitational two weeks ago, and Williams won the 2025 NESCAC women’s title, its sixth straight. The women’s 6K starts at 11:00 a.m. ET and the men’s 8K at noon ET.
